hits.tldr: MongoDB composite types embed records within other records using the type keyword.
Embedded documents in Prisma MongoDB are defined with `type` blocks and live inside parent documents without their own collections.
Composite types embed records within models using the `type` block, available on MongoDB in Prisma v3.10+.
Composite types, MongoDB embedded documents, enable nesting records within records via Prisma find, create, update, and delete operations.
Composite types in Prisma ORM enable embedding records within other records, available only with MongoDB.

:::warning
Composite types are only available on MongoDB.
:::

Composite types (embedded documents) allow embedding records inside other records:

```prisma
model Product {
  id     String  @id @default(auto()) @map("_id") @db.ObjectId
  name   String
  photos Photo[]
}

type Photo {
  height Int
  width  Int
  url    String
}
```

**Supported attributes in composite types:** `@default`, `@map`, native types (`@db.ObjectId`)

**Not supported:** `@unique`, `@id`, `@relation`, `@ignore`, `@updatedAt`"}

structuredContent.text:
## Defining composite types (MongoDB)

:::warning
Composite types are only available on MongoDB.
:::

Composite types (embedded documents) allow embedding records inside other records:

```prisma
model Product {
  id     String  @id @default(auto()) @map("_id") @db.ObjectId
  name   String
  photos Photo[]
}

type Photo {
  height Int
  width  Int
  url    String
}
```

**Supported attributes in composite types:** `@default`, `@map`, native types (`@db.ObjectId`)

**Not supported:** `@unique`, `@id`, `@relation`, `@ignore`, `@updatedAt`
